# Skills

41 skills ship in `.agents/skills/`. Each line is the skill's own description, which is what an agent reads to decide whether to load it.

- [**academic-writing**](../../.agents/skills/academic-writing/SKILL.md): Draft, revise, or audit evidence-bound empirical manuscripts and theses. Use when working on manuscript prose, argument structure, section conventions, or claim-level academic revision; use hierarchical-draft for a new long-form draft that needs gated architecture first.
- [**apa-document-formatting**](../../.agents/skills/apa-document-formatting/SKILL.md): Format the headings of a Word document, or any document with section headings, per APA 7th edition using direct paragraph formatting instead of Word's built-in Heading styles, with single line spacing. Use when creating a manuscript, review, memo, report, or letter for the researcher, unless they ask for a different format for that document.
- [**audit-research**](../../.agents/skills/audit-research/SKILL.md): Audit the research vault read-only for structural integrity and return prioritized findings. Use when the user asks to audit the vault's links, tags, tasks, dashboards, handoffs, routines, or file placement; never repair during the audit.
- [**audit-vaults**](../../.agents/skills/audit-vaults/SKILL.md): Run read-only structural audits of both the research vault and the literature wiki and merge prioritized findings. Use when the user explicitly asks to audit both; use the single-vault audit skill otherwise.
- [**audit-wiki**](../../.agents/skills/audit-wiki/SKILL.md): Audit the literature wiki read-only for lint errors, unaudited work, count drift, orphan concepts, and state-log inconsistencies. Use when the user asks for a wiki audit; never repair during the audit.
- [**autonomous-work**](../../.agents/skills/autonomous-work/SKILL.md): Show, prepare, refresh, or execute persistent project-owned autonomous workload cards. Use when the user says “start working through autonomous tasks”, “show autonomous work across my projects”, or asks to prepare more eligible agent work. Ordinary task prioritization stays with plan-my-day or triage.
- [**calendar-schedule**](../../.agents/skills/calendar-schedule/SKILL.md): Extract, validate, and conflict-check calendar events and, when authorized, write them to macOS Calendar.app. Use when the user asks to extract, conflict-check, add, modify, or delete calendar events; requires explicit event-level authority for live Calendar.app writes.
- [**coding**](../../.agents/skills/coding/SKILL.md): Implement, debug, review, or refactor readable and reproducible research software, analysis pipelines, vault automation, or Unity/C# experiment code. Use when the task changes or evaluates code; use statistics, methods, or experiment-design for unresolved scientific choices.
- [**collaborate**](../../.agents/skills/collaborate/SKILL.md): Keep the researcher in the loop on key decisions — architecture, data models, tool or library choice, hard-to-reverse actions, precedent-setting conventions, and matters of taste — with a teaching decision card, clickable choices, or a generated HTML decision page. Use when work reaches such a decision, or when the researcher invokes /collaborate to be walked through a session. Do not use for choices with one clear standard answer, or in unattended runs.
- [**companion-chat**](../../.agents/skills/companion-chat/SKILL.md): Act as the read-only companion that evaluates another agent's completed transcript or diff and dispatches the follow-up worker prompt. Use when a Claude Code or Codex transcript, diff, log, or commit is pasted in for interpretation and a Keep/Revert/Amend disposition, or when the next bounded worker prompt must be engineered. Do not use to review your own in-progress work (use code-review) or to implement a change.
- [**cover-letter**](../../.agents/skills/cover-letter/SKILL.md): Draft or revise journal submission cover letters, R&R cover letters, point-by-point reviewer responses, or complete response packages. Use when the user asks to write, check, or revise correspondence to an editor or reviewers; use feedback-reconcile to route incoming comments into project tasks.
- [**email-action-scan**](../../.agents/skills/email-action-scan/SKILL.md): Scheduled-only, unattended local scan of a work mailbox via Apple Mail for genuine action items and privacy-safe task routing. Use when the authorized email-action-scan routine launches on this Mac; do not invoke interactively or from cloud sessions.
- [**experiment-design**](../../.agents/skills/experiment-design/SKILL.md): Design behavioral or cognitive-neuroscience study architecture, including manipulation, sampling, assignment, counterbalancing, validity threats, feasibility, and preregistration decisions. Use when the user is choosing or evaluating how a study is structured; use methods for measurement and statistics for estimands or models.
- [**feedback-reconcile**](../../.agents/skills/feedback-reconcile/SKILL.md): Reconcile advisor markup, reviewer comments, or collaborator feedback into the project's canonical task authority. Use when project-level feedback arrives and must be classified, routed, superseded, or escalated; use cover-letter to draft the outward response.
- [**hierarchical-draft**](../../.agents/skills/hierarchical-draft/SKILL.md): Build a new long-form academic draft through architecture, claim-level evidence grounding, and prose synthesis gates. Use when drafting a manuscript section, dissertation chapter, study proposal, or grant aim from scratch; use academic-writing directly for revision or polishing of existing prose.
- [**improve**](../../.agents/skills/improve/SKILL.md): Survey a codebase read-only and produce prioritized, self-contained implementation plans for another agent to execute. Use when the user asks for codebase improvement opportunities, technical debt, bugs, security, performance, test coverage, migrations, developer experience, product direction, or an implementation handoff; do not implement fixes.
- [**init-project**](../../.agents/skills/init-project/SKILL.md): Scaffold a new repository, or non-destructively retrofit an existing one, with the agent orientation quintet (AGENTS.md, ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/PROJECT_HISTORY.md), harness adapters, and an archetype payload for a data pipeline, Unity/VR experiment, LaTeX manuscript, or reusable package. Use when initializing a project repository or auditing one for missing agent-orientation layers; use sync-docs for an already scaffolded manuscript's review round.
- [**learn-style**](../../.agents/skills/learn-style/SKILL.md): Learn the researcher's authorial voice from a direct revision or approved writing sample. Use when the researcher provides an original agent draft and their approved version, edits an AI-written email or academic passage, asks to capture a style lesson, or supplies a representative sample for an approved exemplar bank.
- [**meeting-prep**](../../.agents/skills/meeting-prep/SKILL.md): Create a grounded one-on-one or lab-group meeting prep note in the vault inbox. Use when the user asks to prepare for a meeting; use meeting-prep-auto only for the scheduled unattended routine.
- [**meeting-prep-auto**](../../.agents/skills/meeting-prep-auto/SKILL.md): Scheduled-only, unattended meeting preparation from current calendar and vault context with mandatory deduplication. Use when the authorized meeting-prep-auto routine launches; never ask questions or replace manual meeting-prep.
- [**methods**](../../.agents/skills/methods/SKILL.md): Evaluate measurement validity, apparatus and acquisition tradeoffs, calibration, data quality, preprocessing principles, and methodological evidence. Use when the user is choosing or auditing how a construct is measured or a signal is acquired; use statistics for inferential models and experiment-design for study architecture.
- [**orchestrate**](../../.agents/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md): Decompose multi-step work into bounded sub-tasks and delegate the independently verifiable ones to in-session subagents without asking. Use when starting any task with more than one work item — a plan, build, refactor, migration, audit, review sweep, batch pass, or long-form draft with separable parts — and before the first edit. Do not use for a single-file change, and never delegate architecture, scientific interpretation, or task routing.
- [**plan-my-day**](../../.agents/skills/plan-my-day/SKILL.md): Synthesize current handoffs, daily notes, deadlines, and project state into a ranked daily work list with human-only versus agent-executable actions. Use when the user asks to plan or prioritize the day; use triage to mutate the needs-triage queue.
- [**presentations**](../../.agents/skills/presentations/SKILL.md): Draft native Touying (Typst) research presentations from a user-approved narrative arc using assertion-evidence headlines, sparse audience-facing copy, and a paired companion explainer when needed. Use when creating research talks, journal clubs, and synthesis decks; use a document skill for PowerPoint or native Google Slides artifacts.
- [**prompt-engineering**](../../.agents/skills/prompt-engineering/SKILL.md): Design, revise, or evaluate reusable prompts and agent instructions for a defined task and harness. Use when prompt behavior, model calibration, or prompt evaluation is the deliverable; do not use for ordinary task execution that merely needs a clear request.
- [**read-only-task-tracker**](../../.agents/skills/read-only-task-tracker/SKILL.md): Maintain a read-only task-tracking conversation for a vault, repository, or project, and generate precise handoff prompts for more capable implementation agents. Use when the user wants current tasks, priorities, status, blockers, completed work, next actions, or copy-paste prompts tracked and reported without implementing changes.
- [**reference-verification**](../../.agents/skills/reference-verification/SKILL.md): Audit a specified manuscript bibliography, BibTeX file, reference list, or Zotero export against authoritative bibliographic records and return field-level proposed corrections. Use when performing submission-stage reference metadata verification; use zotero-manager for library maintenance and academic-writing for claim-to-source suitability.
- [**results-parity**](../../.agents/skills/results-parity/SKILL.md): Audit every reported number in a manuscript, abstract, table, deck, or poster against the code output that produced it and against every other place the same number appears. Use when checking quantitative consistency before a submission or presentation; use reference-verification for bibliographic metadata and statistics for whether the analysis itself is appropriate.
- [**scientific-figures**](../../.agents/skills/scientific-figures/SKILL.md): Design, build, revise, or audit evidence-bound scientific figures and legends for behavioral and cognitive-neuroscience manuscripts, grants, and talks, including illustrative scanpath overlays on VR frames built with the shared figure kit. Use when a task concerns a quantitative or predicted plot, a multi-panel figure, a paradigm or scanpath illustration, figure source-data mapping, or rendered figure QA; use presentations for slide layout and imagegen only for explicitly requested conceptual bitmap art.
- [**session-closeout**](../../.agents/skills/session-closeout/SKILL.md): Reconcile evidence-backed completion in a research vault, including canonical authorities, validation, one handoff, and remaining gates. Use when substantive work ends or the user explicitly requests closeout; use walkthrough only to format the final evidence section.
- [**statistics**](../../.agents/skills/statistics/SKILL.md): Guide estimand-first statistical design, diagnostics, uncertainty, sensitivity, power or precision, and quantitative interpretation for behavioral and cognitive-neuroscience research. Use when the user must choose, evaluate, or interpret an estimand, model, contrast, diagnostic, exclusion consequence, or quantitative claim.
- [**sync-docs**](../../.agents/skills/sync-docs/SKILL.md): Manage the two-way lifecycle between canonical LaTeX source and advisor or collaborator Word reviews with live Zotero citation fields. Use when opening, diffing, reconciling, or closing an existing Word review round; use init-project (manuscript archetype) to scaffold the repository first.
- [**task-audit**](../../.agents/skills/task-audit/SKILL.md): Audit the open-checkbox backlog for tasks already completed in practice, confirm them in batched interactive review, and reconcile the confirmed ones. Use when the user asks to audit, reconcile, or clean up open tasks. Do not use for the #needs-triage queue (that is triage) or for today's ranked work list (that is plan-my-day).
- [**theory**](../../.agents/skills/theory/SKILL.md): Develop and evaluate competing theoretical accounts, mechanistic links, construct distinctions, critical tests, and hypothesis logic using current local evidence. Use when the user asks what a phenomenon means, which mechanism explains it, or what evidence would distinguish accounts; use experiment-design to operationalize the test.
- [**triage**](../../.agents/skills/triage/SKILL.md): Interactively cluster, route, prioritize, and resolve the #needs-triage task queue with the researcher's confirmation. Use when the user asks to triage tasks or process #needs-triage; use plan-my-day for read-only daily prioritization, and task-audit to reconcile already-completed tasks or bulk-reschedule stale dates.
- [**vault-export**](../../.agents/skills/vault-export/SKILL.md): Export a lab-facing document from canonical vault Markdown to Word on an authorized OneDrive destination (export-clean-docx.py) or to Google Docs (export_gdoc.py), and pull a Google Doc back as Markdown for comparison. Use when the user explicitly authorizes the export in the current session; do not use for general document editing or unapproved external writes.
- [**walkthrough**](../../.agents/skills/walkthrough/SKILL.md): Format the evidence and verified sign-off section for a CLI session walkthrough. Use when session-closeout delegates final walkthrough formatting or the user explicitly requests a walkthrough artifact; do not reconcile authorities or create a second closeout.
- [**when2meet**](../../.agents/skills/when2meet/SKILL.md): Extract, analyze, or compare participant availability from a When2meet poll URL or event ID, find mutual meeting windows for teams or subsets of participants, and generate Obsidian availability notes. Use when the user shares a When2meet link, asks to check group or individual availability, or needs to schedule meetings based on a poll.
- [**workflow-overview**](../../.agents/skills/workflow-overview/SKILL.md): Regenerate and republish a shareable AI-workflow overview page (and generated reference lists) from the skill registry, the rules README, and a hand-written story. Use when your parity check reports an overview as out of date, or when asked to refresh or publish the overview. Do not use to author or change the skills and rules the page describes.
- [**youtube-meeting-titles**](../../.agents/skills/youtube-meeting-titles/SKILL.md): Generate hilarious, genre-accurate YouTube video titles and clickbait email subject lines for meetings, calendar invites, research syncs, and lab communications based on attendees, agenda, and stakes. Use when naming meetings like YouTube videos, drafting clickbait email subjects, adding flair to calendar events, or injecting humor into lab scheduling.
- [**zotero-manager**](../../.agents/skills/zotero-manager/SKILL.md): Manage Zotero discovery, metadata, attachments, missing-evidence diagnosis, and MinerU acquisition or synchronization. Use when the user must find or repair a library item or determine whether local evidence exists; route complete source ingestion to LLM Wiki `$ingest`.
